mission.title: Quia Superbis Resistis
mission.description: Set up a relay so the Merovingian can speak to the General, and be there when the General's broadcast comes in.

npc.say: Eh? Why are you still here? Allez!
He's got a lot on his mind, mate.
Ah, well. She can't stay lucky forever.
No, no guards--we're trying to stay under the radar. That's really all you can do when the Machines are on the warpath--if you want to stay alive, anyway.
It's a very low-power signal. It can't be used for real-time communication, but it's ideal for small messages that you don't want anyone to notice.

There are times, mon ami, when it is necessary to take matters in hand. Certainement, monsieur le General has been...disappointing, but I think you must agree that as the head of a squadron under our command outside the Matrix, he may still have his uses, n'est-ce pas?
A Sentinel force of our own opens up a number of...strategic possibilities, as the General might have said.

phase.briefing:
One hates to say "I told you so," so I'll just settle for giving you the news, in case you've been even more oblivious than usual for the past week.
The kill-code attempt on the Oracle by an Elite Commando failed. That brat known as "The Kid" took the bullet, trying to play the hero. It doesn't appear to have killed him, unfortunately, but we can hope.
The Merovingian is not in the best of moods. So, you'll be pleased to know that I'm sending you to him to carry out a task of some kind. Avoiding eye contact might help.

enter.say: That's where you're meeting the Merv. Hope we can get out of this in one piece.

talk.say: Oh, it's you. Yes, I want you to set up a relay to the General. I have something to speak with him about. Flood will know what you must do. Go.

near.say: He's got a lot on his mind, mate.
Ah, well. She can't stay lucky forever.

phase.briefing:
Hmph. We had a relay set up to reach the General in the outside world, but it stopped working. I suspect that one of his Sentinels managed to give away its position. We're working on one they can't possibly get at, but I see the Merovingian wants a rush job in the meantime, with the usual risk of loss of life to his loyal followers. Then again, since it's just you, I have no real qualms about it.
You'll have to establish contact via our low-band channel in order to tell them the frequency to use for the emergency broadcast. This channel can't transmit much data, but it is hard to detect. You can use it to send an encoded message from the data center you see marked on your map.

enter.say: The data center's in there--computer signals and a few low-level programs on my screen.

done.say:
All right, that should be all you need to do there, so--
Uh, so yeah, get out of there, fast. I've got Machine signals headed your way!

phase.briefing:
Another loss to add to the tab... Oh, well, there's a reason we keep those centers low-budget.
Assuming that the General receives the notification, he'll attempt to broadcast to a receiver, which you will configure now. As the Machines will almost certainly detect this transmission and cut it off as soon as they are able, you're simply going to hack a civilian media center.

enter.say:
Okay, you have to find the right terminal inside. Once you punch in, I'll be able to run the script that will override their system when it detects the General's signal.
Just a bunch of blues on my screen. Should be a piece of cake.

done.say: Easy-peasy! I'll take care of getting the override script set up on that thing.

near.say: That's just about the stupidest thing I've ever heard, Tiffiny. What the hell gave you that idea?
Well, there was that guy who jumped from that building in Creston... I checked, and his mom was a jumper, too. So, you know, I figured it could be hereditary.
I can't believe we pay these people.
I think I'm onto something here. I'm not gonna drop this just because Hunter doesn't know what real research is.
Uh... Nope, wrong machine.
So I was like "Gah..." and he was like "Duh..."
Totally!
Hm? Oh, nothing. We were just laughing about the, um...joke email from last week. Funny, huh?
Can I help you?
I think we need to work the gun control thing. Deaths by firearms are up 89% in the last two years! Come on, that's huge!
Old news, Angelic. Nobody cares about handguns anymore. Get me biological warfare, dirty bombs--WMD anything, for crying out loud!
This city is going straight to the dogs.
I need a story with some zing! Nobody cares about the small stuff anymore.
Did you ever get the feeling like...like this is all just a big TV show someone else is watching?
This is a TV show. That's our job.
That wasn't what I meant... Oh, what's the use.
I really need to start getting out of the office on my lunch breaks.

phase.briefing: If you haven't screwed something up--and that is no minor caveat--the General should be in touch shortly. As the Machines are monitoring frequencies vigorously at the moment, it will likely be a short broadcast, so you'd better hurry if you're going to be there to catch it for the mission report you owe me.

enter.say: That's the place. I'm not detecting any unusual transmissions, so hopefully you're still in time for the show.

talk.say:
Your commando failed me, General, and this is the last failure I am inclined to tolerate from you. I am taking direct command of your Sentinels. You will find that for you, failure is quite literally no longer an option.
Malphas! Initiate the override program!

Don't be ridiculous. You have no command over us here. Be glad that I--
...

We took the liberty of inserting override routines when we transferred the General and his commandos out of the Matrix. Now that we have activated these routines, the commando Sentinels are programmatically compelled to obey instructions from the Merovingian. It should make them significantly easier to manage.

near.say: Shh!
We're expecting fireworks.

mission.finish:
Yes, well, it's about time. I was for simply deleting the old fool, but as usual my irrefutable logic was overlooked. He's an obsolete program known only for incompetence.
Bah! At least he's out of the city for good.
